generationInputs.prompt: A dark green heart outline contains illustrations of produce and botanical elements against a white backdrop. Inside the left of the heart are three red apples with green leaves and brown stems, a cluster and two individual dark blue blueberries with some green leaves. The right side of the heart features four orange carrots with green leafy tops, a bunch of green broccoli, a red chili pepper, and four stalks of wheat with golden grains. A thick, dark green curved line on the exterior forms a partial heart or vine shape and encloses four individual flat, solid-colored leaves: a diagonal green leaf at the top, a yellow leaf pointing upwards, a central blue leaf pointing downwards with a thin, light green stem extending below it, and a horizontal red leaf to the right.
